fit: oral macadamia oil and plasma lipids in randomized dietary periods
assessment: The abstract describes three diets in 34 men, with macadamia oil used as a palmitoleic source. It provides plasma lipid results without pressing grade, Parkinson disease or a resting-tremor effect. Full methods and adverse-event reporting remain inaccessible.

fit: synthetic racemic butylphthalide plus donepezil and aggregate UPDRS
assessment: Liu randomized 84 Parkinson dementia patients. Table 2 gives week-12 total UPDRS 20.32 versus 35.12 for adjunct and comparator (p<.01). Rest tremor is an eligibility or baseline phenotype and does not have a follow-up item estimate.

fit: pharmaceutical butylphthalide add-on and aggregate UPDRS
assessment: The original abstract reports 90 randomized participants and post-treatment totals 33.28 versus 41.26. Full tables and trial dates remain gated. It supplies no raw stalk exposure or separate rest-tremor outcome.

fit: pharmaceutical adjunct in Parkinson dementia with broadly defined motor score
assessment: The 73-person original author abstract reports a composite improvement without item, score values or timing. The full paper remains gated. The pharmaceutical treatment differs from raw celery stalk.

fit: combined reported cucurbit intake and occurrence of Parkinson disease
assessment: The original author reply from the 2013 case-control cohort gives adjusted RR 1.00 (95% CI 0.72–1.38) per daily frequency of pooled cucurbits. It provides no separate raw cantaloupe exposure or symptom severity.

fit: filbertone profiling in cold-pressed hazelnut oils
assessment: Table VI measures semi-quantitative filbertone signals in some cold-pressed preparations. Raw-kernel oils in this study are below the quantification limit. No systemic uptake or tremor outcome was measured.

fit: isolated filbertone with rotarod and treadmill performance in a mouse model
assessment: The primary author dissertation for the same article shows behavioral task results. It supplies no oral hazelnut oil arm, human Parkinson cohort or resting-tremor comparison.

fit: isolated filbertone with biochemical endpoints in cell and mouse models
assessment: The full original gives biochemical and tissue markers. The preprint and article are one family. It provides neither a cold-pressed oil exposure nor a human resting-tremor result.
